title: Action pin check in check:tooling
goal: check:tooling fails on a workflow action not pinned by a 40-character SHA
acceptance: Every `uses:` in `.github/workflows/*.yml` must be `owner/repo@<40 hex>` (local `./` actions and `docker://` digests allowed); a trailing version comment is allowed
Fixtures: all pinned, tag-pinned, branch-pinned, local action, reusable workflow
Failing test committed first: the tag-pinned fixture expects a failure against the current check:tooling; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 1 h plus failing-first fixtures; all nine repositories already comply, so no adoption fixes. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
